OmniLang: a programming language you can write in English, Hindi or Tamil
=========================================================================

1. Put the `omni` program (omni.exe on Windows) somewhere on your PATH,
   or run it from this folder.

2. Try the examples:

     omni run examples/hello.om           English
     omni run examples/primes.om          Hindi  (हिन्दी)
     omni run examples/squares.om         Tamil  (தமிழ்)

3. See any program in another language:

     omni view examples/primes.om --to ta

4. Get error messages in Hindi or Tamil:

     omni run myprogram.om --lang hi

5. Make a stand-alone program (needs gcc or clang installed):

     omni build examples/squares.om

Keywords
--------
                English        Hindi            Tamil
  function      fn             कार्य            செயல்பாடு
  variable      var            चर               மாறி
  if            if x { }       अगर x तो { }     x என்றால் { }
  loop          while x { }    जबतक x { }       x இருக்கும்வரை { }
  print         print x;       x छापो।          x அச்சிடு;
  return        return x;      x लौटाओ।         x திருப்பு;

Run `omni packs` for the full list and `omni --help` for every command.

Editor: install omnilang.vsix in VS Code (Extensions panel > "..." >
"Install from VSIX") for highlighting, errors as you type, and romanized
typing (type "agar" to get अगर).

More: https://github.com/avkad3/Omnilang
